main: Awakening: AoE HP healing, SP healing, and {st:ResultReduction} on clash win. Deal bonus damage on clash lose.
Passive buffs her {kw:Envy} skills, gives her {st:AttackUp} based on the total damage she's taken, and inflicts {st:NiddleEGO} to all enemies on {kw:Envy} A-Reson.
other: Both versions give her shield based on {kw:Envy} Reson on clash lose, letting her tank part of the incoming damage while triggering her clash lose mechanics.

passiveList.desc:
Envy Skills deal +10% damage
- Said Skills deal +1% more damage for every 1 Envy Reson. (max 7%)

Turn Start: Gain [AttackUp] equal to (cumulative HP damage taken by this unit in this Encounter (including Shield damage) / 20) (max 3)

Combat Start: On Envy A-Reson., inflict 1 [NiddleEGO] to all enemies (in Focused Encounters, all Parts)
passiveList.name: 'Tis Thy Turn to Swallow the Needle!
